issue.title: Fresh install fails at the coder stage: `cadpy/step_scene.py` imports `TDF_LabelSequence`, which no longer exists in OCP 8.x (pulled in by unpinned `build123d>=0.8`)

steps: flat plate 100x50x5 mm with four 6 mm holes
expected: The pipeline runs the deterministic coder and produces the CAD part for the request.
defect: Every request halts with `Status: HALTED (ErrorType.FATAL)`, `Iterations: 0` and `Deterministic coder execution failed: cannot import name 'TDF_LabelSequence' from 'OCP.TDF'` before any CAD script runs.

fault location.explanation: `build123d>=0.8` is unbounded, so a fresh install resolves build123d 0.13 with cadquery-ocp-novtk 8.x; commit 2195f00 constrains it to `build123d>=0.8,<0.13`.
cadpy, whose step_scene.py (L32) imports OCP 7.x's TDF_LabelSequence, declares `build123d` and `cadquery-ocp-novtk` with no bounds; 2195f00 pins `build123d>=0.8,<0.13` and `cadquery-ocp-novtk<8`.
The pip install path also uses unbounded `build123d>=0.8`; 2195f00 changes it to `build123d>=0.8,<0.13` (environment.yml L28 likewise).

Root cause: FIXED UPSTREAM IN https://github.com/Pan-Chera/Multi-Agent-CAD/commit/2195f005c5fa2198826e33393561fd35b0c9abac. packages/cadpy/src/cadpy/step_scene.py imports `TDF_LabelSequence` from `OCP.TDF` at module level (L32) and uses it in its STEP traversal; that typedef only exists in OCP 7.x. The project's dependency declarations (root pyproject.toml, packages/cadpy/pyproject.toml, requirements.txt, environment.yml) leave build123d / cadquery-ocp-novtk unbounded, so a fresh install now resolves build123d 0.13.0, which requires cadquery-ocp-novtk 8.x, where the type moved to OCP.collections.Sequence_TDF_Label. The deterministic coder's first `from cadpy.generation import ...` transitively imports cadpy.glb -> cadpy.step_scene, raises ImportError, and the graph halts with ErrorType.FATAL at iteration 0. Commit 2195f00 ("fix(deps): keep CAD runtime on compatible OCP 7", 2026-10-17) constrains build123d to <0.13 and cadquery-ocp-novtk to <8 in all dependency files and documents it; it does not port step_scene.py to OCP 8. The fix is not in any release tag (latest tag v1.0.0 predates it) and is not in the pinned revision f31a2f6, which is older than the reported 8bf91d8. Whether the case reproduces depends on the unit image resolving build123d 0.13.x (round 4: reproduced in ABB).
